$comment: Test build variants (EDR test-build-variants). Each is patches/series plus an explicit list of test-only hooks, built only by a workflow_dispatch of build-macos with test_variant set, and never releasable: check-release fails any artifact carrying seclabTestBuild or a hook marker. Adding a variant or a hook needs a security review round recorded in `review`. A hook's `target` is the artifact it must end up in (desktop or reh); its `marker` is a string literal its code emits, which the build requires in that artifact's output.

containment.description: Rogue-REH containment probes (RPC lockdown): the tab's REH loads the probe payload once the harness stages an armed run in the tab.
